title: subpilocereus repandus subsp. micracanthus
intro: Subpilocereus repandus subsp. micracanthus, commonly known as Pachycereus repandus subsp. micracanthus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a type of columnar cactus native to Mexico, valued for its medicinal properties and versatility. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pachycereus repandus subsp. micracanthus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
